    "chapters": [
      {
        "bridge": {
          "from_prev": "Artie enters the ring for the final match.",
          "to_next": "The System crashes, and Artie is left in the wreckage."
        },
        "chapter_id": 6,
        "chapter_role": "climax",
        "goal": "Defeat Vane and survive the System's attempt to delete Artie.",
        "pacing": {
          "expected_scene_count": 12,
          "intensity": 5,
          "tempo": "rush"
        },
        "sections": [
          {
            "end_condition": "Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.",

            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:2",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "outcome": "Artie's main weapon is now a suicide button.",

                "summary": "Vane enters with legendary armor that reflects 50% of all damage. Artie realizes if he crits Vane, he crits himself.",

                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "legendary gold armor",
                  "reflect damage icon",
                  "suicide button warning",
                  "arena sand"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The final match is announced with a blast of trumpets.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "red scroll glow",
                  "evasion disabled icon",
                  "heavy boots",
                  "mocking laughter"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vane unfurls the black market scroll with a flourish, the parchment bleeding a dark, oily light.",

              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:1",

                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "outcome": "Artie is now a 1 HP character who can't dodge.",
                "scene_id": 2,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Vane uses the 'System Override' scroll to turn off Artie's Evasion stat.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "red scroll glow",
                  "evasion disabled icon",
                  "heavy boots",
                  "mocking laughter"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "A red glow from the scroll washes over Artie, locking his joints and turning his Evasion stat to a flat zero.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "zero-gravity field",
                  "floating sand",
                  "guide sparks",
                  "3D movement"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Fizz's form flickers as she dives into the arena's code, her digital hands tearing at the physics engine.",
                "type": "escalation"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:2",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:4",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "outcome": "Artie can move in 3D, bypassing the 'No-Evasion' ground rule.",
                "scene_id": 3,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 15,
                "summary": "Fizz sacrifices her 'Guide' status to temporarily hack the arena's gravity, giving Artie a few seconds of weightlessness.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "zero-gravity field",
                  "floating sand",
                  "guide sparks",
                  "3D movement"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The sand beneath Artie's feet begins to float as the gravity constant is deleted from the local sector.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "magic aura ripples",
                  "target reticle",
                  "floating sand",
                  "determined glare"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie hovers in the air, his eyes locking onto the shimmering aura around Vane's chest.",
                "type": "choice"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:3",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:5",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "outcome": "Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.",
                "scene_id": 4,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Artie realizes he doesn't need to hit Vane; he needs to hit the 'Reflect' buff itself.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "magic aura ripples",
                  "target reticle",
                  "floating sand",
                  "determined glare"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie's eyes narrow as he spots a glitch in the golden armor's glow, a tiny seam where the math doesn't add up.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "meta-crit spark",
                  "pixelated air",
                  "infinite reflection loop",
                  "system alarm"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie's fist strikes the shimmering air inches from Vane's chest, igniting a spark of pure white code.",
                "type": "reveal"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "Vane's Ultimate Build"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.",
            "intent": "The moment of peak absurdity and power.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:4",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:6",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "outcome": "The arena begins to pixelate and dissolve.",
                "scene_id": 5,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 5,
                "summary": "Artie lands a 'Meta-Crit' on the Reflect buff. The System can't handle the math of a crit reflecting a crit reflecting a crit.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "meta-crit spark",
                  "pixelated air",
                  "infinite reflection loop",
                  "system alarm"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The impact creates a deafening digital screech as the reflection loop hits infinite recursion.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "error message swarm",
                  "flickering armor",
                  "terrified scream",
                  "dissolving sand"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The ground beneath Vane's feet turns into a wireframe grid as the textures fail to load.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:5",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:7",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "outcome": "Vane is defenseless and terrified.",
                "scene_id": 6,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 30,
                "summary": "Vane panics as his armor turns into a swarm of error messages.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "error message swarm",
                  "flickering armor",
                  "terrified scream",
                  "dissolving sand"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Vane's legendary armor flickers and dies, replaced by a cloud of red '404' icons.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "character data fragments",
                  "logout beam",
                  "champion crown",
                  "broken sky"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie delivers a final, glitching punch to Vane's chest, the impact sounding like a corrupted audio file.",
                "type": "escalation"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:6",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:8",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "outcome": "Vane is kicked from the game, and Artie is the champion of a broken world.",
                "scene_id": 7,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Artie delivers the final blow\u2014a crit so powerful it deletes Vane's character data (but not the person).",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                  "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "character data fragments",
                  "logout beam",
                  "champion crown",
                  "broken sky"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Vane's character model shatters into a million blue cubes, caught in a forced logout beam.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "giant floating head",
                  "delete button icon",
                  "booming voice",
                  "static clouds"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "A massive, translucent head appears in the sky above the arena, its eyes burning with administrative wrath.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_BOSS"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "pursued",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:7",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "6:9",
                "introduces": [
                  "CHAR_BOSS"
                ],
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "outcome": "The true antagonist is revealed.",
                "scene_id": 8,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 40,
                "summary": "The System Administrator (a giant floating head) appears to manually delete Artie.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "giant floating head",
                  "delete button icon",
                  "booming voice",
                  "static clouds"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The sky cracks open to reveal the face of the Admin, a visage of cold, unfeeling geometry.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "red delete button",
                  "frozen reality",
                  "glitching fist",
                  "silent crowd"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The Admin's finger descends toward a glowing red button that pulses with the word 'PURGE'.",
                "type": "reveal"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_BOSS"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:8",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:10",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "outcome": "Artie has successfully 'paused' reality.",
                "scene_id": 9,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 15,
                "summary": "Artie crits the Admin's 'Delete' button, causing the entire world to freeze.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "red delete button",
                  "frozen reality",
                  "glitching fist",
                  "silent crowd"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie leaps into the air, his fist glowing with the concentrated power of every broken mechanic he's ever used.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "teleportation beam",
                  "safe mode icon",
                  "dissolving void",
                  "holographic keys"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Fizz's hands move across a holographic keyboard in the absolute silence of a paused universe.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ",
                  "CHAR_BOSS"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:9",
                "end_condition_echo": "They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "6:11",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "outcome": "They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.",
                "scene_id": 10,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 10,
                "summary": "Fizz uses the pause to rewrite Artie's location data, teleporting them out of the arena while the Admin is frozen.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "teleportation beam",
                  "safe mode icon",
                  "dissolving void",
                  "holographic keys"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Fizz works quickly, her eyes reflecting the lines of code that make up Artie's soul.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "wireframe trees",
                  "low-poly ground",
                  "dying world sky",
                  "static wind"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie hits the ground with a soft, digital thud in a forest where the leaves are just green triangles.",
                "type": "choice"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "Breaking the Game"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.",
            "intent": "Show the immediate consequences of the climax.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE",
                  "CHAR_FIZZ"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "sheltered",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:10",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "6:12",
                "location_end": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "location_end_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "location_start_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "outcome": "They are safe for now, but the world is dying.",
                "scene_id": 11,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 65,
                "summary": "Artie and Fizz wake up in a 'Null-Zone' where the graphics are all wireframes.",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "wireframe trees",
                  "low-poly ground",
                  "dying world sky",
                  "static wind"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie opens his eyes to a world of glowing lines and empty space, the sky a flat, unrendered grey.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "nan hp readout",
                  "virus signature",
                  "wireframe hands",
                  "flickering stats"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie opens his character sheet one last time, his breath catching at the corruption he sees.",
                "type": "aftermath"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:11",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "location_end": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "location_end_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "location_start_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "outcome": "Artie is no longer a player; he is a virus.",
                "scene_id": 12,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 15,
                "summary": "Artie looks at his stats and sees his HP is now 'NaN' (Not a Number).",
                "threads": [
                  "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH",
                  "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "nan hp readout",
                  "virus signature",
                  "wireframe hands",
                  "flickering stats"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The status screen flickers with red error messages, the 'HP' bar replaced by a string of nonsensical characters.",
                "type": "reveal"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The Aftermath of the Crash"
          }
        ],
        "stakes_shift": "The survival of the entire game world is threatened as Artie's crits start breaking the source code.",
        "title": "The Final Roll"
      }
    ]
  },
  "phase_report": {
    "candidate_seams": [
      {
        "from_scene_ref": "6:5",
        "requested_resolution": "inline_bridge",
        "seam_score": 30,
        "to_scene_ref": "6:6",
        "trigger_reason": "Location label change from The Finals to Dissolving Reality."
      },
      {
        "from_scene_ref": "6:7",
        "requested_resolution": "micro_scene",
        "seam_score": 40,
        "to_scene_ref": "6:8",
        "trigger_reason": "Location change to The Void and introduction of the Admin."
      },
      {
        "from_scene_ref": "6:10",
        "requested_resolution": "micro_scene",
        "seam_score": 65,
        "to_scene_ref": "6:11",
        "trigger_reason": "Teleportation to a new location (The Null-Zone) and aftermath of the climax."
      }
    ],
    "edits_applied": [
      "Added seam_score and seam_resolution to all scenes.",
      "Adjusted handoff_mode for scene 6:1 to direct_continuation to match the flow into 6:2."
    ],
    "transition_hint_compliance": []
  }
}
